title: Michael confirms the UFO in the first phone call
place_text: November 5 missile site, Ellsworth AFB, South Dakota

tellings.quote: It was It was big though. I remember. We saw it. It was It was white.

plain: An Air Force veteran named Michael Johnson, in his first phone call with his old fellow guard Mario Woods in decades, confirmed that they both saw a UFO at the November 5 missile site near Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota in 1977. Johnson, who was there, tells Michels: "It was big though. I remember. We saw it. It was white." Two witnesses agreeing after nearly 50 years is why the call matters to them.
